achievements.name: The Penitent Two
achievements.description: Unlock all the Achievements.

achievements.name: A Thousand Years Later
achievements.description: Defeat the Faceless One, Chisel of Oblivion (the first boss).

achievements.name: Blood and Dust
achievements.description: Defeat Radames (one of the three guardians).

achievements.name: Blood and Gold
achievements.description: Defeat Orospina of the Confraternity of Embroiderers.

achievements.name: Blood and Iron
achievements.description: Defeat Lesmes and Infanta.

achievements.name: The Sharpest Tool in the Shed
achievements.description: Defeat Afilaor, Sentinel of the Emery.

achievements.name: The Last Ascension
achievements.description: Defeat Benedicta of the Confraternity of Endless Orison.

achievements.name: The Sea dies on the Shore
achievements.description: Defeat Odon of the Confraternity of Salt.

achievements.name: Forged in Fire
achievements.description: Defeat Sinodo, Hymn of a Thousand Voices.

achievements.name: Fermosa Fembra
achievements.description: Defeat Svsona, Fermosa Fembra.

achievements.name: The Wait is Over
achievements.description: Defeat Eviterno, Father of the Penitents.

achievements.name: A Heart of Gold
achievements.description: Defeat Devotion Incarnate (the final boss).

achievements.name: Canvas of Light and Time
achievements.description: Unlock Ending A.

achievements.name: Second Psalm
achievements.description: Unlock Ending B.

achievements.name: Acta, Non Verba
achievements.description: Find all of the Prayers in the base game.

achievements.name: Full Devotion
achievements.description: Find all of the Rosary Beads in the base game.

achievements.name: Weight of Penance
achievements.description: Find all of the Figures in the base game.

achievements.name: Second Pilgrimage
achievements.description: Reveal the entire base game's map.

achievements.name: Acquired Taste
achievements.description: Unlock all Bile Flasks.

achievements.name: Soledad
achievements.description: Unlock all of the Rosary Bead slots.

achievements.name: Still Among Us
achievements.description: Find all of the hidden symbols.

achievements.name: No Cherub Left Behind
achievements.description: Free Próximo’s brothers.

achievements.name: Empty Handed
achievements.description: Purchase all available items in the shop in the City of the Blessed Name.

achievements.name: Hide and Seek
achievements.description: Find all the hidden Cobijadas.

achievements.name: The Work of a Master
achievements.description: Bring every Remembrance to an artisan and turn them into Figures.

achievements.name: House of Grief and Hatred
achievements.description: Complete all the battle challenges.

achievements.name: A Leap of Faith
achievements.description: Lift the Curse of the Unforgiven.

achievements.name: Twisted is the Path of the Miracle
achievements.description: Hear the echoes of the past.

achievements.name: The Punished One
achievements.description: Kill 300 enemies using Ruego Al Alba.

achievements.name: The Veteran One
achievements.description: Kill 300 enemies using Sarmiento & Centella.

achievements.name: The Anointed One
achievements.description: Kill 300 enemies using Veredicto.

achievements.name: The Merciless One
achievements.description: Execute 50 different enemies.

achievements.name: Nobody Expects the Spanish Inquisition!
achievements.description: Kill every type of enemy in the base game.

achievements.name: Ultima Ratio
achievements.description: Unlock all four movement abilities: Wall Climbing, Double Jump, Air Dash and the Angel Rings (Scion's Protection).

achievements.name: A Sharp Rendezvous
achievements.description: Reach the room of the Sentinel of the Emery in under 30 minutes.

achievements.name: Flawless Penance
achievements.description: After the first fight, defeat any boss without receiving damage.

achievements.name: Blessed Incense
achievements.description: Unlock the true power of Veredicto.

achievements.name: Storm of Death
achievements.description: Unlock the true power of Sarmiento & Centella.

achievements.name: Edge of Orison
achievements.description: Unlock the true power of Ruego Al Alba.

achievements.name: Warrior of the Silent Sorrow
achievements.description: Unlock all Weapon Memories.

achievements.name: Welcome Back!
achievements.description: Fall into spikes and survive.

achievements.name: Happy New Year!
achievements.description: Attack any bell 12 times using Veredicto.

achievements.name: Two Old Ones Eating Soup
achievements.description: Complete the Castula and Trifon quest (obtain both Remembrances and equip the matching Altarpieces together).

achievements.name: The Finest Craftmanship
achievements.description: Unlock all slots in the Altarpiece of Favours.

achievements.name: This is Blasphemy
achievements.description: Deal more than 250 damage with a single strike.

achievements.name: Martyrdom
achievements.description: Complete 100% of the game.

achievements.name: In Repose
achievements.description: (DLC) Defeat Sor Cautiva del Silencio.

achievements.name: Prisoner of the Holy Return
achievements.description: (DLC) Defeat Brother Asterion.

achievements.name: At the Mercy of the Grievous Miracle
achievements.description: (DLC) Restore the Mea Culpa sword.

achievements.name: Post-Mortem
achievements.description: Unlock Ending C.

achievements.name: Dedicated Explorer
achievements.description: Reveal the entire map, including new areas.

achievements.name: Consummate Collector
achievements.description: Collect all items on an Ascended playthrough.

achievements.name: Mind Your Head
achievements.description: (DLC) Raise the Guillotine above the prisoner in the Icebound Mausoleum.

achievements.name: Cruel Compassion
achievements.description: (DLC) Find the prisoner after releasing him.

achievements.name: Legacy of the Twisted One
achievements.description: (DLC) Unlock the true power of Mea Culpa by obtaining all 9 Weapon Memories.

achievements.name: Atonement of Sins
achievements.description: (DLC) Defeat Crescencia, Duchess of the Sleeping Face.

achievements.name: Embrujo of the Flames
achievements.description: (DLC) Unlock the full power of Embrujo using all 19 Marks.

achievements.name: Chorus of the Servants
achievements.description: (DLC) Collect all four servant fragments and consecrate them at the chalice in the Usurped Halls.

achievements.name: Omnis Facies Poenitentiae
achievements.description: (DLC) Get all 8 skins for The Penitent One.

achievements.name: Unbreakable Bond
achievements.description: (DLC) Reach Level 4 on all Servants.
